research.note: Follow-up of all 19 prior holds, two specific-form gaps and explicitly reviewed common names. additions.label: fat choy (black moss)
additions.description: Edible hair-like Nostoc flagelliforme material used as fat choy/black moss in Chinese cooking, commonly sold dried. Distinct from Irish moss, seaweed and other botanical mosses.

additions.label: daylily flower buds
additions.description: Culinary flower buds of daylilies (Hemerocallis); species and fresh/dried state are unspecified. Distinct from Lilium lily bulbs and from an explicitly dried bud product.

additions.label: dried daylily buds
additions.description: Daylily flower buds processed by drying for cooking; distinct from fresh/unspecified buds and from lily bulbs. Exact species is unspecified.

additions.label: dried roselle calyces
additions.description: Roselle (Hibiscus sabdariffa) calyces preserved by drying, used in infusions and cooking. Distinct from dried ground roselle, roselle leaves and Rumex sorrel leaves.

additions.label: roselle jam
additions.description: Sweet preserve made from roselle/hibiscus calyces, called sorrel jam in Caribbean cooking. Exact spice and sugar formulation varies; distinct from Rumex-leaf preparations.

additions.label: Colombian aliños sauce
additions.description: Colombian vegetable-and-spice seasoning paste/sauce used to marinate or flavor food; commonly includes peppers, onion/scallion and garlic. Recipes vary. Distinct from dry seasoning and unrelated regional aliños.

additions.label: som moo pork sausage
additions.description: Lao-style sour fermented pork-and-pork-skin sausage called som moo, used as a cooking component. Distinct from fresh pork sausage and other regional cured sausages; exact seasoning and fermentation vary.

additions.label: pectin
additions.description: Food-grade pectin used as a gelling ingredient; physical form and sugar/calcium-dependent formulation are unspecified. A generic reference does not establish interchangeability of liquid, powdered or low-sugar products.

additions.label: powdered pectin
additions.description: Food-grade pectin supplied as a dry powder for gelling. Exact sugar/calcium formulation is unspecified; distinct from liquid pectin and from a recipe-specific instant or low-sugar product.

additions.label: tuna packed in olive oil
additions.description: Prepared tuna preserved/packed in olive oil for use as an ingredient. Can/jar packaging, tuna species and solid/chunk/flake presentation are unspecified; distinct from fresh tuna and tuna in brine or other oils.

additions.label: ground coriander seed
additions.description: Coriander seed ground into spice powder; distinct from whole seeds and coriander leaves. Grinding changes measurement and flavor release; no roasting or seasoning is inferred.

additions.label: golden raisins
additions.description: Light golden-colored dried grapes sold as golden raisins; seed status and exact drying process are unspecified. Distinct from an explicitly seedless golden-raisin product and from dried Ribes currants.

additions.label: red vermouth
additions.description: Red/rosso-style aromatized fortified wine used in drinks and cooking; exact sweetness and botanical formula are unspecified. Distinct from an entry defined only as sweet vermouth, which need not be red.

additions.label: pul biber
additions.description: Turkish-style crushed red chili flakes sold as pul biber; heat, pepper variety and oil/salt additions are unspecified. Do not identify the unqualified term specifically as Urfa or Aleppo pepper.

additions.label: sweet pickled piquanté peppers
additions.description: Piquanté-type peppers preserved in a sweet vinegar pickle. Heat and exact formulation are unspecified; distinct from fresh peppers, generic sweet pickled bell peppers and cheese-stuffed pepper products.

additions.label: imitation vanilla flavouring
additions.description: Vanilla-flavored baking ingredient made with imitation/artificial flavoring rather than an extract of vanilla pods. Color, alcohol level and concentration are unspecified; distinct from vanilla extract.
